lines.text: The LORD says he will forgive Jerusalem if one just person is found, yet the people swear falsely and refuse to repent.
The speaker goes to the powerful, but they too have broken the yoke, so a bear from the forest will strike them.
The children swore by gods that are not gods, so the LORD asks whether He should not punish them.
The LORD says the people said the LORD would do nothing, so He will make His words a flood in their mouths.
The LORD will bring a distant nation whose language they do not know, and they will serve foreigners in a land not their own.
